rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the power or right to command, make rules, or impose obligations.

example.english: The boss has the authority to decide this.
example.traditional: 老闆有權力決定呢件事。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 jau5 kyun4 lik6 kyut3 ding6 ni1 gin6 si6

rows.note: Use this for official authorities as a group; when the context specifically means the police, Cantonese normally says 警方 instead.

example.english: The authority is urging residents not to go to that area for now.
example.traditional: 當局呼籲市民暫時唔好去嗰區。
example.jyutping: dong1 guk6 fu1 jyu6 si5 man4 zaam6 si4 m4 hou2 heoi3 go2 keoi1

rows.note: Use this for a person or source regarded as a definitive expert on a subject.

example.english: He is an authority on cancer research.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 jin4 gau3 ngaam4 zing3 ge3 kyun4 wai1

rows.note: Use this for official authorization or permission to act on behalf of an organization or governing body.

example.english: The company officially gave me authority to sign the contract on its behalf.
example.traditional: 公司正式授權我代表佢哋簽約。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zing3 sik1 sau6 kyun4 ngo5 doi6 biu2 keoi5 dei6 cim1 joek3
